content:
Who would have thought the new iPhone launch week is here again?

Apple's "Rise and Surprise" event will be held at 1:00 AM Hong Kong time on Wednesday, September 10. Reports suggest the company will unveil a foldable iPhone Ultra, along with several other new hardware products such as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Word has it that this year's new colour for the Pro series is a deep cherry red.

As a fan of Cosmic Orange, I can't imagine myself being equally excited about the rumoured wine-red colour. However, the following AI-generated mock ad demonstrates just how well this colour can actually look.

Moreover, the quality of AI-generated videos is genuinely getting better and better. A special shoutout to them for clearly labelling this mock ad as AI-generated, without trying to pass it off as a leaked clip. It's quite a fun creation — hopefully the actual new colour will look just as good.
